about: Every version of every schema lab-in-a-box reads, oldest first. A breaking version raises MAJOR and names the libs/migrations.py step that migrate_config.py applies; see CONTRIBUTING.md, Schema versions.

addon:anthropic.changes: The LiteLLM proxy installs from the OCI chart anthropic_chart (default oci://ghcr.io/berriai/litellm-helm); anthropic_rel and anthropic_repo_url removed. No database; clients use the master key in the anthropic-proxy-master-key secret; the API key is kept in a secret; the ingress uses the chart's ingress.hosts.

addon:apertus.changes: Defaults written as literal values, or left unset where the code computes them: apertus_tag.

addon:appcollection.changes: Defaults written as literal values, or left unset where the code computes them: appcollection_chart, appcollection_release.

Logs helm in to the OCI registry appcollection_registry (default dp.apps.rancher.io) with the new mandatory appcollection_user and appcollection_password, or the credential file appcollection_account; installs appcollection_chart from oci://<registry>/charts with the pull secret application-collection. appcollection_rel and appcollection_repo_url removed.

addon:client_registration.changes: Defaults written as literal values, or left unset where the code computes them: client_registration_admin_pass, client_registration_server_ip, client_registration_server_node, client_registration_server_type.

addon:codellama.changes: Defaults written as literal values, or left unset where the code computes them: codellama_model.

addon:complianceascode.changes: Installs Rancher's compliance operator (rancher-compliance, or rancher-cis-benchmark for older Kubernetes) from https://charts.rancher.io, picking the chart version for the cluster's Kubernetes version, and runs a CIS scan (new complianceascode_scan). complianceascode_profile is a ClusterScanProfile name; complianceascode_ns removed.

addon:ds389.changes: Defaults written as literal values, or left unset where the code computes them: ds389_dm_password, ds389_image, ds389_ldap_nodeport, ds389_ldaps_nodeport, ds389_name, ds389_ns, ds389_storage_class, ds389_storage_size.

addon:gemini.changes: The LiteLLM proxy installs from the OCI chart gemini_chart (default oci://ghcr.io/berriai/litellm-helm); gemini_rel and gemini_repo_url removed. No database; clients use the master key in the gemini-proxy-master-key secret; the API key is kept in a secret; the ingress uses the chart's ingress.hosts. The default model is gemini/gemini-2.5-flash (gemini-1.5-flash is retired).

addon:gitlab.changes: Defaults written as literal values, or left unset where the code computes them: gitlab_deployment, gitlab_edition, gitlab_hostname, gitlab_http_port, gitlab_https, gitlab_https_port, gitlab_image, gitlab_namespace, gitlab_rel, gitlab_repo_url, gitlab_ssh_port, gitlab_version.

addon:grafana.changes: Defaults written as literal values, or left unset where the code computes them: grafana_admin_password, grafana_image.

addon:hermes.changes: Defaults written as literal values, or left unset where the code computes them: hermes_dashboard_user, hermes_git_ref, hermes_image_tag, hermes_llm_provider, hermes_ns, hermes_shorthn, hermes_storage_class, hermes_storage_size.

addon:home_assistant.changes: Defaults written as literal values, or left unset where the code computes them: home_assistant_image_tag, home_assistant_ns, home_assistant_rel, home_assistant_repo_url, home_assistant_shorthn, home_assistant_storage_class, home_assistant_storage_size.

addon:jenkins.changes: New jenkins_ns and jenkins_shorthn. Installs from <jenkins_rel>/jenkins with jenkins_version, through the chart's own ingress (service jenkins:8080) instead of an ingress to jenkins-server:443, and registers the hostname in DNS.

addon:kagent.changes: Charts install from the OCI registry kagent_registry (kagent-crds, then kagent); kagent_rel and kagent_repo_url removed. New kagent_provider, kagent_model, kagent_api_key and kagent_ollama_host select the default model provider. The web UI gets an ingress and a DNS record.

addon:keycloak.changes: Installs codecentric/keycloakx (official Keycloak image, development mode) instead of bitnami/keycloak, whose images are no longer published; defaults keycloak_rel codecentric and keycloak_repo_url https://codecentric.github.io/helm-charts. The bootstrap admin comes from the keycloak-admin secret; an unset keycloak_password is generated once and kept instead of keycloak123.

addon:kimi.changes: Defaults written as literal values, or left unset where the code computes them: kimi_api_base.

The LiteLLM proxy installs from the OCI chart kimi_chart (default oci://ghcr.io/berriai/litellm-helm); kimi_rel and kimi_repo_url removed. No database; clients use the master key in the kimi-proxy-master-key secret; the API key is kept in a secret; the ingress uses the chart's ingress.hosts.

addon:linkerd.changes: Installs from the edge channel (linkerd_rel linkerd-edge, linkerd_repo_url https://helm.linkerd.io/edge; the stable channel ended at 2.14). The mesh identity is generated once and kept in the linkerd-lab-identity secret; the Gateway API CRDs are installed only when the cluster has none.

addon:mailman.changes: Defaults written as literal values, or left unset where the code computes them: mailman_admin_email, mailman_admin_user, mailman_ns, mailman_shorthn, mailman_version.

addon:mariadb.changes: Defaults written as literal values, or left unset where the code computes them: mariadb_bind_address, mariadb_db, mariadb_password, mariadb_root_password, mariadb_user.

addon:mistral.changes: Defaults written as literal values, or left unset where the code computes them: mistral_model.

addon:nextcloud.changes: Defaults written as literal values, or left unset where the code computes them: nextcloud_admin_password, nextcloud_admin_user, nextcloud_airgap, nextcloud_assistant, nextcloud_db, nextcloud_db_password, nextcloud_db_root_password, nextcloud_deployment, nextcloud_flow, nextcloud_groupware, nextcloud_hostname, nextcloud_http_port, nextcloud_image, nextcloud_max_upload_size, nextcloud_namespace, nextcloud_redis, nextcloud_redis_version, nextcloud_rel, nextcloud_repo_url, nextcloud_talk, nextcloud_version.

addon:openai.changes: The LiteLLM proxy installs from the OCI chart openai_chart (default oci://ghcr.io/berriai/litellm-helm); openai_rel and openai_repo_url removed. No database; clients use the master key in the openai-proxy-master-key secret; the API key is kept in a secret; the ingress uses the chart's ingress.hosts.

addon:postgresql.changes: Kubernetes mode runs a StatefulSet of registry.suse.com/suse/postgres:<postgresql_pg_version> (new postgresql_image, postgresql_storage) instead of the Bitnami chart, whose images are no longer published; postgresql_rel, postgresql_repo_url and postgresql_version removed. postgresql_pg_version applies to both modes.

addon:prometheus.changes: Defaults written as literal values, or left unset where the code computes them: prometheus_image, prometheus_port, prometheus_retention, prometheus_version.

addon:rancher.changes: An unset rancher_repo_url selects Rancher Prime (https://charts.rancher.com/server-charts/prime) instead of the stable repo, an unset rancher_rel is rancher-prime, an unset rancher_helm_chart is rancher-prime/rancher instead of none, and an unset rancher_initial_pwd lets Rancher generate the bootstrap password.

addon:seafile.changes: Defaults written as literal values, or left unset where the code computes them: seafile_admin_email, seafile_admin_password, seafile_cache_provider, seafile_db_password, seafile_db_root_password, seafile_deployment, seafile_edition, seafile_hostname, seafile_jwt_private_key.

addon:smlm.changes: Defaults written as literal values, or left unset where the code computes them: smlm_activation_key_desc, smlm_activation_key_enable_config_deployment, smlm_activation_key_universal_default, smlm_byos, smlm_chart, smlm_coco_image, smlm_db_ha, smlm_db_ha_cnpg_version, smlm_db_ha_pg_image, smlm_db_ha_replicas, smlm_db_ha_size, smlm_db_ha_sync, smlm_deployment, smlm_email, smlm_img_tag, smlm_ingress_class, smlm_lh_overprovision, smlm_ns, smlm_org, smlm_preinstalled, smlm_registry, smlm_rel, smlm_salt_auto_accept, smlm_shorthn, smlm_super_privileged.
Add optional scripts to smlm_kickstart_profiles entries (kickstart.profile.addScript).

addon:smlm_proxy.changes: Defaults written as literal values, or left unset where the code computes them: smlm_proxy_admin_pass, smlm_proxy_admin_user, smlm_proxy_email, smlm_proxy_img_repository, smlm_proxy_img_tag, smlm_proxy_max_cache, smlm_proxy_scc_password, smlm_proxy_scc_user, smlm_proxy_server, smlm_proxy_server_node.

addon:stackpack.changes: Defaults written as literal values, or left unset where the code computes them: stackpack_cluster_name.

addon:starcoder2.changes: Defaults written as literal values, or left unset where the code computes them: starcoder2_model.

addon:struts_demo.changes: Defaults written as literal values, or left unset where the code computes them: struts_demo_attacker.

addon:suse_ai.changes: Defaults written as literal values, or left unset where the code computes them: suse_ai_components, suse_ai_ns, suse_ai_registry, suse_ai_shorthn.
Added suse_ai_regcode and suse_ai_scc_account (registry.suse.com pull secret), suse_ai_ollama_models and suse_ai_gpu.

addon:traefik.changes: New traefik_ingress_class (default traefik-standalone, not the cluster default; the release serves only that class) and traefik_service_type (default NodePort), so the release runs next to the cluster's own ingress controller.

addon:trento.changes: Defaults written as literal values, or left unset where the code computes them: trento_secret_key.

Installs Trento Server from the OCI chart trento_chart (default oci://registry.suse.com/trento/trento-server); trento_rel and trento_repo_url removed. trento_admin is the admin user name (default admin); trento_password and trento_secret_key default to values the chart generates and keeps. New trento_ingress_class (default traefik).

addon:uyuni.changes: Defaults written as literal values, or left unset where the code computes them: uyuni_activation_key_desc, uyuni_activation_key_enable_config_deployment, uyuni_activation_key_universal_default, uyuni_admin, uyuni_email, uyuni_org, uyuni_password, uyuni_ssl_password.

config:lab_creation.cfg.changes: Add optional CLOUD_DNS_IMAGE: the image the cloud DNS VM boots from.

lab.changes: Add optional kclusters.clu_token: the join token set on the first rke2/k3s server.
